_README: MACHINE-READABLE GROUND TRUTH for ballistics-forge. GENERATED by offline_tool/ballistic_model.py from researched anchors (do not hand-edit — edit the model's GUNS table + rerun). vret/tof are validated against real firing-table anchors; drop is bore-referenced (NOT the sight-referenced table drop columns). See docs/ballistics_research_notes.md + ballistics_reference.md.
test_condition: Flat fire: shooter at rest, muzzle horizontal, still air, ICAO sea-level density 1.225 kg/m^3, g=9.81. Range = horizontal ground distance. Drop is bore-referenced.

MG151_20.name: 20mm MG 151/20, Minengeschoss (thin-wall HE)
MG151_20.source: MV 805 (Williams/L.Dv.4000-10, M-Gesch); k SHARED with MG-FF/M (same 92g projectile), which pins it to a primary velocity anchor. No open firing table; table is model-derived. See research_notes.

MG17_792.name: 7.92mm MG 17, sS ball
MG17_792.source: Real transcribed German sS Schusstafel (whq-forum, energy col arithmetic-verified); model reproduces it to <1% per 100 m. NB combat cowl guns fired -v rounds ~855 m/s (SmK-v) — Chad decision, sS is the 760 m/s config default.

MG131_13.name: 13mm MG 131, AP-T (off-airframe, reference)
MG131_13.source: MV 710 AP-T (dewiki/Warbirds/L.Dv.4000-3); k from OCR'd Handbuch retained-velocity column (velocity col self-consistent; its drop/tof cols were OCR-misaligned and discarded).

MGFF_M_20.name: 20mm MG-FF/M, Minengeschoss (off-airframe, reference)
MGFF_M_20.source: MV 700 M-Gesch (Williams/L.Dv.4000-10; 585 is the heavy HE, NOT the mine shell); k fitted to primary velocity anchors — pins the 92g M-Geschoss drag shared with MG 151/20.
